articles.summary: Royal Gold, Inc. (NASDAQ: RGLD) (together with its subsidiaries, “Royal Gold,” the “Company,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) announced today the appointment of Mr. Harry Kenyon-Slaney as an independent member to the Board of Directors (the “Board”) effective immediately, increasing the size of the Board to eight Directors. A former member of Rio Tinto’s Group Executive Committee, Mr. Kenyon-Slaney adds to the Board’s significant mining industry expertise. Additionally, the Board is recommending an amendment to our certificate of incorporation to declassify the Board following our 2027 Annual Meeting of Stockholders (the “Annual Meeting”). “Royal Gold has a strong Board of Directors with the experience required to provide leadership and oversight in our unique business,” commented Bill Hayes, Chairman of Royal Gold. “Harry adds to that strength with a perspective earned through a four-decade career in operating, commercial and C-suite roles. articles.title: Royal Gold Strengthens Board of Directors with Appointment of Experienced Mining Executive Harry Kenyon-Slaney and Recommendation for Declassification
